text_units.verbatim_text: Supplementary Table 5 Practical guidance on the use of sacubitril/valsartan (angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitor) in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fractiona

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: To improve symptoms, reduce the risk of HF hospitalization, and increase survival.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Patients with HFrEF as a replacement for ACE-I/ARB.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: It may be considered in patients with HFrEF in those who are ACE-I/ARB naïve (*de novo* use).

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: History of angioedema.a

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Known bilateral renal artery stenosis.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pregnancy/risk of pregnancy and breastfeeding period.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Known allergic reaction/other adverse reaction (drug-specific).

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: eGFR $<30$ mL/min/1.73 m2.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Symptoms of hypotension or a SBP $95$ mmHg at randomization)

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: A washout period of at least 36 h after ACE-I therapy is required in order to minimize the risk of angioedema.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Significant hyperkalaemia ( $K^+ > 5.0$ mmol/L).

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Drug interactions to look out for:

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: $K^+$ supplements/ $K^+$ -sparing diuretics, e.g. amiloride and triamterene (beware combination preparations with furosemide).

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: MRAs.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Renin inhibitorsc.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: NSAIDsd.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Trimethoprim/trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: 'Low-salt' substitutes with a high $K^+$ content.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Sac/Val: starting dose 49/51 mg *b.i.d.*\*, target dose 97/103 mg *b.i.d.*

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: In the community in stable patients (NYHA class IV/patients with severe HF and those with a current/recent exacerbation should be referred for specialist advice).

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients hospitalized with worsening HF—after stabilizing, relieving congestion, and if possible, restoring 'euvolaemia' (but ideally before discharge).

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Other exceptions—see 'Cautions/seek specialist advice'.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Check renal function and electrolytes.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Start with a low dose (see Guidelines, Table 8).

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: In some patients, one may consider a reduced starting dose (24/26 mg *b.i.d.*), namely in those with SBP 100–110 mmHg, ACE-I/ARB naïve patients, eGFR 30–60 mL/min/1.73 m2.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Double the dose at not less than 2-week intervals in the community, monitoring tolerability.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Aim for the target dose (see above) or, failing that, the highest tolerated dose.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Re-check blood chemistry (urea/BUN, creatinine, $K^+$ ) 1–2 weeks after initiation and 1–2 weeks after final dose titration.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Consider reducing diuretic where appropriate.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Monitor blood chemistry 4-monthly thereafter.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: When to stop uptitration, reduce dose, stop treatment—see PROBLEM SOLVING.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is very rarely necessary to stop an ARNI, and clinical deterioration is likely if treatment is withdrawn. Ideally, specialist advice should be sought before treatment discontinuation.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: A specialist HF nurse may assist with education of the patient, follow-up (in person or by telephone), biochemical monitoring, and dose uptitration.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Does not usually require any change in therapy.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Dizziness/light-headedness is common and often improves with time—patients should be reassured.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Reconsider need for any other vasodilators and reduce dose/stop, if possible.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: If no signs or symptoms of congestion, consider reducing diuretic dose.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: If these measures do not solve problem, seek specialist advice.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Cough is common in patients with HF, many of whom have smoking-related lung disease.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Cough is also a symptom of pulmonary oedema, which should be excluded when a new worsening cough develops.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: When a troublesome cough does develop (e.g. one stopping the patient from sleeping) and can be proved to be due to ARNI and ACE-I (i.e. recurs after the drugs withdrawal and re-challenge), substitution of an ARB is recommended.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Some rise in urea (BUN), creatinine, and $K^+$ is to be expected after an ARNI; if an increase is small and asymptomatic, no action is necessary.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: A reduction in eGFR up to $\leq 30$ mL/min/1.73 m2 is acceptable.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: An increase in $K^+$ up to $\leq 5.5$ mmol/L is acceptable.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: If urea, creatinine, or $K^+$ does rise excessively, consider stopping concomitant nephrotoxic drugs (e.g. NSAIDsd) and other $K^+$ supplements or retaining agents (triamterene, amiloride) and, if no signs of congestion, reducing the dose of diuretic. This is particularly true in those patients on an SGLT2 inhibitor.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: If greater rises in creatinine or $K^+$ than those outlined above persist despite adjustment of concomitant medications, the dose of the ARNI should be halved and blood chemistry re-checked within 1–2 weeks; if there is still an unsatisfactory response, specialist advice should be sought.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: If $K^+$ rises to $> 5.5$ mmol/L or eGFR lowers to $< 30$ mL/min/1.73 m2, the ARNI should be stopped and specialist advice sought.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Blood chemistry should be monitored frequently and serially until $K^+$ and creatinine have plateaued.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Explain expected benefits:

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Improved symptoms.

normative_assertions.notes: Descriptive/contextual source text; no normative action is inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: Prevention of worsening of HF leading to hospital admission.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Increased survival (reduction in both CV and all-cause mortality).

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Symptoms improve within a few weeks to a few months after starting treatment.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Advise patients to report principal adverse effects (i.e. dizziness/symptomatic hypotension, cough)—see PROBLEM SOLVING.

normative_assertions.notes: Agent-silver extraction preserves explicit source wording and inherited table context; human adjudication remains required.

text_units.verbatim_text: Advise patients to avoid NSAIDsd not prescribed by a physician (i.e. purchased over-the-counter) and salt substitutes high in K+—see PROBLEM SOLVING.
